name: gh
description: GitHub and git workflow skills. /gh:sync moves a checkout to its default branch, fast-forwards it, and prunes branches whose work has already landed. /gh:shepherd merges every auto-merge-enabled pull request one at a time, and each stack once every layer is ready, optionally by one label, rebasing, merging the base branch to resolve conflicts, and waiting on CI, and skips what it cannot explain or verify. gh:issues files, links and triages issues with duplicate checks, relationship fields, milestone, type and priority.
